name: bt_reset
sql: delete from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('r5','r7','r10','nf5','nf7','nf10'); select 1 ok

name: regression_gate
sql: do $$ declare a int; b int; c int; begin select count(*) filter (where run_id='r5'), count(*) filter (where run_id='r7'), count(*) filter (where run_id='r10') into a,b,c from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest'; if (a,b,c) <> (320,196,111) then raise exception 'REGRESSION: floor-1.30 backtest %/%/% <> 320/196/111', a,b,c; end if; end $$; select 'regression pass' ok

name: regression_same_alerts
sql: select r.run_id, count(*) filter (where o.id is null) new_not_in_old from ten280_bot.alerts r left join ten280_bot.alerts o on o.mode='backtest' and o.run_id = replace(r.run_id,'r','bt') and o.fixture_id=r.fixture_id and o.side_id=r.side_id and o.eval_at=r.eval_at where r.mode='backtest' and r.run_id in ('r5','r7','r10') group by 1 order by 1

name: split_by_tier
sql: select run_id, tier, count(*) alerts, count(distinct fixture_id) matches, count(*) filter (where cur_price < 1.30) below_130 from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('r5','r7','r10','nf5','nf7','nf10') group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: detect_delay
sql: select tier, cur_src, count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9]) within group (order by extract(epoch from eval_at - cur_at)) secs from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='nf5' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: sample_nf5_below130
sql: select message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='nf5' and cur_price < 1.30 order by eval_at desc limit 2

name: startup_v2
sql: insert into ten280_bot.events (kind, detail, net_request_id, delivery) select 'startup_v2', jsonb_build_object('at', now()), rid, case when rid is null then 'unsent: no vault secret' else 'queued' end from (select ten280_bot.send('✅ Stennisfy — Bet105 drop bot UPDATED (test message).' || chr(10) || 'Alerts: Bet105 match winner, ATP / Challenger / ITF Men, pre-match. Fires on a ≥5% drop vs the price 10 min earlier; 30-min cooldown per match.' || chr(10) || 'Test phase: drops to prices below 1.30 are included.' || chr(10) || 'New alert layout below; "Moved" = time from the price change to this message. Times in UTC.') rid where not exists (select 1 from ten280_bot.events where kind = 'startup_v2')) s returning id, delivery

name: format_test
sql: insert into ten280_bot.events (kind, detail, net_request_id, delivery) select 'format_test', jsonb_build_object('alert_id', a.id, 'text', m.msg), ten280_bot.send(m.msg), 'queued' from (select * from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id limit 1) a cross join lateral (select '🧪 FORMAT TEST — re-send of the first live alert (' || ten280_bot.hhmm(coalesce(a.sent_at, a.eval_at)) || '); Moved is as of now' || chr(10) || chr(10) || ten280_bot.render(a, clock_timestamp()) as msg) m where not exists (select 1 from ten280_bot.events where kind = 'format_test') returning id, delivery

name: delivery_gate
sql: select ten280_bot.settle(); do $$ declare d1 text; d2 text; begin select delivery into d1 from ten280_bot.events where kind='startup_v2' order by id limit 1; select delivery into d2 from ten280_bot.events where kind='format_test' order by id limit 1; if d1 is distinct from 'sent' or d2 is distinct from 'sent' then raise exception 'NOT DELIVERED: startup_v2 % format_test %', d1, d2; end if; end $$; select 'delivered' ok

name: telegram_echo
sql: select e.kind, e.delivery, r.status_code, (r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text') = coalesce(e.detail->>'text', (r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text')) as text_identical, length(r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text') - length(replace(r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text', chr(10), '')) as line_breaks, r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text' as echoed from ten280_bot.events e left join net._http_response r on r.id = e.net_request_id where e.kind in ('startup_v2','format_test') order by e.id

name: events_all
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at from ten280_bot.events order by id

name: cron_job
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot'
